returned_objects.answer: Hypothesis: Elevated checkout failures are likely a regression introduced by the recent checkout deployment, not a payments dependency issue. Cited observations: checkout error rate rose from 1% at 09:00 to 18% at 09:12 and p95 latency increased from 240 ms to 1800 ms, while payments API error rate remained at ~1% throughout. Checkout build 8f21 was deployed at 09:10, immediately before the error spike; payments service last deployed two days ago and no rollback has occurred. Recommended next step: per runbook, compare the changed code in checkout build 8f21 and verify database migration status for checkout, and collect additional service logs/traces to confirm root cause before any remediation. Rollback requires incident commander approval and no production changes should be made now. Correlation alone does not identify root cause.
